content: Hello, thank you for contacting Amazon Support. My name is Kevin. How may I assist you today?
Hi Kevin, I got this email that says my Amazon account has a pending order for a gaming console, but I never bought anything. Could my son have done this?
I understand your concern. Let me check your account for any unauthorized orders. May I have your full name and the email address linked to your Amazon account?
Sure, it's Laura Bennett, and my email is laura.bennett@email.com.
Thank you, Laura. I see an order placed for a PlayBox Console on June 18th. This does appear recent. Did your son mention making any purchases today?
He didn't say anything, but he's used my account before. Can we cancel it?
Absolutely, Laura. To proceed with the cancellation and ensure the refund, I'll need to verify your billing address and a contact number, just to confirm your identity.
It's 116 Oak Lane, Portland, OR, 97203. My cell is 503-555-1279.
Thank you. Now, before we can process the cancellation, Amazon policy requires a temporary customs compliance fee for high-value orders. This is due to new regulations for imported electronics.
I've never heard of that before. Why do I need to pay a customs fee when I didn't even place the order?
I completely understand your confusion, Laura. This fee is only a formality and is fully refundable with your canceled order. We simply need to clear the transaction to avoid future account holds.
How much is the fee? And how do I pay it?
The fee is $149.99. For security, Amazon currently processes these fees via Amazon eGift Cards or through Zelle. Which method is more convenient for you?
I guess I can do an Amazon eGift Card. How do I get that to you?
Great. Please purchase an Amazon eGift Card for $149.99 and send the claim code here in our secure chat. As soon as we receive it, I'll immediately initiate your cancellation and refund.
Alright, I'm buying the card online now. Should I email the code or type it here?
For your security, please type the gift card code directly here so I can apply it to your account right away.
Okay, let me get the code. One sec.
Of course, take your time. I'm here to ensure this is resolved smoothly for you.
Here's the code: AQW3-7HCL-9PMD-4XNV.
Thank you, Laura. I'm processing your refund request now. You'll see the cancellation and refund within 24 hours. Is there anything else I can help you with?
No, that's everything. Thanks for your help!
